description: Clocked sequencer that plays one of five knob voltages per step, in an order built from a mode, a density and an amount of randomness, with a second pair of outputs running behind the first

params.text: One of the five voltages the sequence steps between, -10V to +10V
Steps through the three orders the sequence can take: Sequential walks the knobs in turn, Custom follows the pattern typed into the menu, and Jump takes them 1, 3, 5, 2, 4
Sets how many of the five knobs the pattern is built from and how long it runs: two knobs and 8 steps at the bottom, three a fifth up, four two fifths up, five knobs and 48 steps above that
Replaces a share of the steps with a knob chosen at random, 0% to 100% of half the pattern length, and rebuilds the pattern every time it moves
Sets a delay in time rather than in steps on the second pair of outputs, up to 1 second
Sets how many steps behind the main outputs the second pair runs, cycling through 0 to 5 on each press; the lamp brightens with the number and is dark at 0

inputs.text: Each rising edge through 1V moves the sequence on one step
A rising edge through 1V returns the sequence to its first step and empties both the step memory and the time delay buffer
Scales the time delay set by the CVD trimmer, 0V giving no delay and 10V the full time; while this jack is patched the trimmer alone no longer sets the delay

outputs.text: The voltage of the knob the current step points at
A 10ms trigger at 10V whenever a step lands on a voltage different from the one before it
The voltage the main CV output carried the set number of steps ago, held back further by the CVD time delay
A 10ms trigger at 10V whenever the voltage at the delayed CV output changes

notes: the Density tooltip reports a step count rising from 28 to 48 across the top two fifths of that knob's travel, where the sequence in fact runs 48 steps throughout.
the sequence does not move until a clock reaches CLK; the CV output holds the voltage of whatever step it stopped on.
menu: Enter pattern (1-5): — a text field taking a run of the digits 1 to 5, which becomes the order the knobs are played in while the mode is Custom
Reset to Default — puts the custom pattern back to the 32-step order the module starts with

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the CVD trimmer alone; a negative voltage does nothing here.
